mapper.select: select exists(select 1 from t_usr_interest where int_user_id = #{userId} and int_target_type = 2 and int_target_id = #{companyId} and int_status = 1)
mapper.insert: insert into t_usr_interest (int_user_id, int_target_type, int_target_id, int_status, int_created_at, int_updated_at) values (#{userId}, 2, #{companyId}, 1, now(), now()) on duplicate key update int_updated_at = if(int_status = 1, int_updated_at, now()), int_status = 1
mapper.update: update t_usr_interest set int_status = 0, int_updated_at = now() where int_user_id = #{userId} and int_target_type = 2 and int_target_id = #{companyId} and int_status = 1
mapper.select: select i.int_target_id from t_usr_interest i join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = i.int_target_id and c.cmp_status = 1 where i.int_user_id = #{userId} and i.int_target_type = 2 and i.int_status = 1 order by i.int_updated_at desc, i.int_id desc
mapper.update: update t_msg set msg_is_read = 1, msg_read_at = coalesce(msg_read_at, now()) where msg_receiver_id = #{userId} and msg_type = 4 and msg_is_read = 0 and msg_target_url like concat('/companies/', #{companyId}, '?positionId=%')
mapper.select: select pos_status from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read, msg_target_url, msg_created_at) select i.int_user_id, 0, 4, concat(c.cmp_name, ' · 企业动态'), concat('发布了新的「', p.pos_title, '」职位。'), 0, concat('/companies/', c.cmp_id, '?positionId=', p.pos_id), now() from t_pos p join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = p.pos_company_id and c.cmp_status = 1 join t_usr_interest i on i.int_target_id = c.cmp_id and i.int_target_type = 2 and i.int_status = 1 where p.pos_id = #{positionId} and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and p.pos_status = 1 and not exists (select 1 from t_msg m where m.msg_receiver_id = i.int_user_id and m.msg_type = 4 and m.msg_target_url = concat('/companies/', c.cmp_id, '?positionId=', p.pos_id))
